versions.changelog:
Initial release of cmcc-newmsg (cmcc-commod-message), a tool for sending and receiving China Mobile 5G (RCS) messages.

- Supports text, image, audio, video, and general file sending.
- CLI-based tool with optional Skill integration; Hermes compatible.
- Includes local configuration/credential management and state directory auto-detection.
- Provides message listening/receiving (optionally downloads media, with security filters).
- Enforces strict security: outbox-only file sending, API Key never shown, and command execution protections.
- Includes diagnostic and connection test commands (`init`, `check`, `doctor`).
